run_compare_results: run compare_results.py to compare OpenEvolve and Iterative Agent results on the K-Module problem
load_openevolve_results: load OpenEvolve checkpoint results from an output directory and extract scores and iterations
load_iterative_results: load Iterative Agent metrics files from an output directory and extract scores and iterations
plot_comparison: generate a comparison plot showing convergence speed and best scores for both approaches
print_summary: print a summary comparison of OpenEvolve and Iterative Agent results including solution speedup
